question: List all students in CSE branch
sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE branch = 'CSE';

question: How many students are from Bengaluru?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE city = 'Bengaluru';

question: Show the average CGPA of all students
sql: SELECT AVG(cgpa) FROM students;

question: List students with CGPA above 8.5
sql: SELECT name, cgpa FROM students WHERE cgpa > 8.5;

question: How many courses are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses;

question: List all course names
sql: SELECT course_name FROM courses;

question: Show students from Mysuru
sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE city = 'Mysuru';

question: What is the highest marks scored in any course?
sql: SELECT MAX(marks) FROM marks;

question: What is the lowest attendance recorded?
sql: SELECT MIN(attendance) FROM marks;

question: List the top 5 students by CGPA
sql: SELECT name, cgpa FROM students ORDER BY cgpa DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Show students whose attendance is below 60 in any course
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.id = m.student_id WHERE m.attendance < 60;

question: What is the average marks in DBMS?
sql: SELECT AVG(m.marks) FROM marks m JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'DBMS';

question: How many students are in ECE branch?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE branch = 'ECE';

question: List students who scored more than 90 marks in any subject
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.id = m.student_id WHERE m.marks > 90;

question: Show the average attendance across all students
sql: SELECT AVG(attendance) FROM marks;

question: Which branch has the most students?
sql: SELECT branch, COUNT(*) AS total FROM students GROUP BY branch ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List students from Mangaluru with CGPA above 7
sql: SELECT name, cgpa FROM students WHERE city = 'Mangaluru' AND cgpa > 7;

question: What is the total number of credits across all courses?
sql: SELECT SUM(credits) FROM courses;

question: Show the name and marks of students who passed DBMS with more than 40 marks
sql: SELECT s.name, m.marks FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.id = m.student_id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'DBMS' AND m.marks > 40;

question: List courses with 4 credits
sql: SELECT course_name FROM courses WHERE credits = 4;

question: How many students have CGPA between 7 and 8?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE cgpa BETWEEN 7 AND 8;

question: List the top 3 students by marks in Algorithms
sql: SELECT s.name, m.marks FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.id = m.student_id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Algorithms' ORDER BY m.marks DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What is the average CGPA of CSE students?
sql: SELECT AVG(cgpa) FROM students WHERE branch = 'CSE';

question: Show students who have attendance of at least 75 in all their courses
sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marks m WHERE m.student_id = s.id AND m.attendance < 75);

question: List all students in semester 5
sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE semester = 5;

question: What is the maximum CGPA among ISE students?
sql: SELECT MAX(cgpa) FROM students WHERE branch = 'ISE';

question: How many students scored less than 50 in Operating Systems?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marks m JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Operating Systems' AND m.marks < 50;

question: Show average marks per course
sql: SELECT c.course_name, AVG(m.marks) AS avg_marks FROM courses c JOIN marks m ON c.course_id = m.course_id GROUP BY c.course_name;

question: List students whose name starts with A
sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE name LIKE 'A%';

question: What is the average marks of ECE students in all subjects?
sql: SELECT AVG(m.marks) FROM marks m JOIN students s ON m.student_id = s.id WHERE s.branch = 'ECE';

question: List courses offered by the CSE department
sql: SELECT course_name FROM courses WHERE branch = 'CSE';

question: Which city has the highest number of students?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS total FROM students GROUP BY city ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show students with marks above 80 in NLP
sql: SELECT s.name, m.marks FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.id = m.student_id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'NLP' AND m.marks > 80;

question: How many students are enrolled in each semester?
sql: SELECT semester, COUNT(*) AS total FROM students GROUP BY semester ORDER BY semester;

question: What is the minimum marks scored in Computer Networks?
sql: SELECT MIN(m.marks) FROM marks m JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Computer Networks';

question: List students who scored exactly 100 in any subject
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.id = m.student_id WHERE m.marks = 100;

question: Show the average CGPA grouped by branch
sql: SELECT branch, AVG(cgpa) AS avg_cgpa FROM students GROUP BY branch;

question: List students from Hubballi or Mysuru
sql: SELECT name, city FROM students WHERE city IN ('Hubballi', 'Mysuru');

question: What is the total marks scored by each student across all courses?
sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(m.marks) AS total_marks FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.id = m.student_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY total_marks DESC;

question: Show students with attendance above 90 in Cloud Computing
sql: SELECT s.name, m.attendance FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.id = m.student_id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Cloud Computing' AND m.attendance > 90;
